description: This file defines a PyTorch module for interfacing with Android's NNAPI, including a class for wrapping NNAPI compilation, functions for converting models to NNAPI, and shape computation utilities.

classes.name: NnapiModule
classes.description: PyTorch Module that wraps an NNAPI compilation, handling preparation, initialization, and execution of NNAPI models.

classes.name: NnapiInterfaceWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class to adapt NNAPI models for flexible input/output handling.

classes.name: ShapeComputeModule
classes.description: Dynamically generated module for tensor shape computation during model conversion.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the NNAPI compilation with model weights and configuration.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the NNAPI model with formatted inputs, producing outputs.

methods.name: convert_model_to_nnapi
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch model to an NNAPI-compatible model wrapped in a Torch module.

methods.name: process_for_nnapi
methods.description: Prepares model and inputs for NNAPI serialization and shape computation.
